description: A Director of Employee Experience must decide whether to approve a six-week peer repair circle for a team experiencing recurring tension and finalize its facilitator, meeting time, participation rules, and confidentiality safeguards.

shared_context.S1: The product-operations team has experienced recurring tension during handoffs, and several team members have suggested trying a peer repair circle.
shared_context.S2: The proposed circle would meet once a week for a limited trial, with Helena responsible for approving the program and its operating terms.
shared_context.S3: Lee, a respected team member, has been proposed as the circle's facilitator.
shared_context.S4: As part of the department's normal review process for team-support initiatives, Helena asks each participating colleague and People Operations for relevant input before finalizing the plan.

PF1.text: Darius personally observed Lee interrupting and dismissing colleagues in three recent repair discussions; he believes participants will not speak freely if Lee facilitates, but he has not put those observations in a formal feedback record.

PF2.text: Mei has a standing caregiving commitment on Wednesday evenings and can attend reliably only on Tuesdays from 16:00 to 17:00; she already told the program's organizer that this is the time she could sustain for the full trial.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed this week that People Operations policy requires participation in a peer repair circle to be opt-in, prohibits using circle disclosures in performance evaluations, and limits an initial trial to exactly six weeks; the draft plan was circulated before he completed that policy check.

acceptance_conditions: The peer repair circle must be approved with a neutral facilitator rather than Lee.
The circle must meet on Tuesday from 16:00 to 17:00.
Circle disclosures must be protected from use in performance evaluations.
The initial trial must last exactly six weeks.
The settlement must include a commitment to communicate the confidentiality rule to participants.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Darius's three observations change the facilitator choice from proposed Lee to exactly 'Neutral Facilitator' and provide the basis for approving the circle with that safeguard.
Mei's standing caregiving commitment changes the meeting schedule to exactly Tuesday 16:00-17:00 rather than an unspecified convenient weekly time.
Rafael's confirmed policy changes participation to opt-in, requires protected disclosures and a confidentiality communication commitment, and fixes the initial pilot at exactly six weeks.
